([[Bradenton, Florida]]) | college = * [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] (2019–2023) * [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]] (2023–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | career_start = 2024 | years1 = {{nbay|2024|full=y}} | team1 = [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] | years2 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team2 = →[[Iowa Wolves]] | years3 = 2025–2026 | team3 = [[Melbourne United]] | years4 = 2026 | team4 = [[Saski Baskonia|Baskonia]] | highlights = * Third-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] (2023) * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Defensive team (2023) }} '''Jesse David Edwards''' (born 18 March 2000) is a Dutch professional [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse Orange]] and the [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia Mountaineers]]. Standing at {{height|m=2.13}}, he plays the [[Center (basketball)|center]] position. He also plays for the [[Netherlands men's national basketball team]]. ==Early life== Edwards was born in [[Amsterdam]] to a Dutch mother and a British father. He grew up with two siblings.{{cite news|first=James|last=Szuba|title=The Mad Professor: Jesse Edwards ready to make his mark with Syracuse basketball|url=https://www.nunesmagician.com/2021/11/9/22769965/the-mad-professor-jesse-edwards-netherlands-ready-to-make-his-mark-with-syracuse-basketball|work=[[Troy Nunes Is An Absolute Magician]]|date=9 November 2021|access-date=15 December 2021}} He started playing basketball at age 14 and later joined the youth section of [[Apollo Amsterdam]]. After graduating [[Amsterdams Lyceum]] high school in the Netherlands, he went on to play on the Post Grad team for [[IMG Academy]], a boarding school in [[Bradenton, Florida]]. While playing for Apollo Amsterdam, he played together with Warriors' center [[Quinten Post]].{{Cite web |date=2022-12-31 |title=Jeugdvrienden Edwards en Post treffen elkaar in topaffiche college basketbal |url=https://www.espn.nl/other/artikel/_/id/11419634/jeugdvrienden-edwards-en-post-treffen-elkaar-in-topaffiche-college-basketbal |access-date=2024-09-18 |website=ESPN.nl |language=nl}} Edwards received offers by [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]] and [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]], among others. He committed to playing college basketball for [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] in April 2019. {{College Athlete Recruit Start|collapse=no|year=2019}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | Basketball: Jesse Edwards is confident despite a lack of run|url=https://insidetheloudhouse.com/2021/01/09/syracuse-basketball-jesse-edwards-confident-despite-lack-run/|website=InsideTheLoudHouse.com|publisher=[[FanSided]]|date=9 January 2021|access-date=28 December 2021}} As a sophomore, he averaged 1.9 points and 2.6 rebounds per game.{{cite web|first=Adam|last=Zagoria|title=After reaching the Sweet 16, the Syracuse roster is in flux|url=https://www.zagsblog.com/2021/03/31/after-reaching-the-sweet-16-the-syracuse-roster-is-in-flux/|website=ZagsBlog.com|date=31 March 2021|access-date=28 December 2021}} On 5 December 2021, he recorded his first career double-double, after recording 11 points and 12 rebounds against [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]].{{cite news|first=James|last=Szuba|title=Syracuse's Jesse Edwards records first career double-double before fouling out at Florida State|url=https://www.nunesmagician.com/2021/12/5/22818551/syracuse-basketball-jesse-edwards-records-first-career-double-double-fouling-out-at-florida-state|work=Troy Nunes Is An Absolute Magician|date=5 December 2021|access-date=22 December 2021}} On 8 February 2022, Edwards broke his left wrist during a game against [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College]], ending his season. He averaged 12 points and 6.5 rebounds per game as a junior, shooting 69.5 percent.{{cite news|title=Syracuse basketball player Jesse Edwards breaks left wrist, out for season|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33261604/syracuse-basketball-player-jesse-edwards-breaks-left-wrist-season|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=10 February 2022|access-date=11 February 2022}} In the 2022–23 season, Edwards averaged 14.5 points, 10.3 rebounds, and 2.7 blocks per game, shooting 59.2 percent.{{cite web|title=ESPN player bio|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/4431816/jesse-edwards/|website=ESPN.com|access-date=18 July 2024}} In April 2023, Edwards transferred to [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]].{{cite news|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|title=West Virginia lands Syracuse transfer Edwards|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/36205941/west-virginia-lands-syracuse-transfer-jesse-edwards|website=ESPN.com|date=16 April 2023|access-date=23 April 2023}} He averaged 15.0 points on 61.3% shooting from the field, 8.0 rebounds and 1.7 blocks per game. ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Edwards signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] on 9 July 2024.{{cite news|title=Timberwolves Sign Jesse Edwards to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-sign-jesse-edwards-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=9 July 2024|access-date=18 July 2024}} He was called minutes after the draft ended by the Timberwolves, he told ESPN Netherlands.{{Cite web |last=von Burg |first=Luuk |date=2024-06-27 |title=Edwards tekent bij Minnesota Timberwolves: "Een nieuwe fase voor het Nederlandse basketbal" |url=https://www.espn.nl/nba/artikel/_/id/13839535/jesse-edwards-tekent-nba-contract-bij-minnesota-timberwolves?platform=android&appsrc=sc |access-date=2024-09-18 |website=ESPN.nl |language=nl}} Edwards made his NBA debut on 2 March 2025 against the [[Phoenix Suns]]. He subbed in for [[Anthony Edwards (basketball)|Anthony Edwards]] for the remaining 1:35 of the fourth quarter. Edwards became the third Dutch player to make his NBA debut that season, following [[Malevy Leons]] and [[Quinten Post]].{{Cite web |date=2025-03-03 |title=Edwards debuteert voor Timberwolves, derde Nederlander in NBA dit seizoen |url=https://nos.nl/l/2558003 |access-date=2025-03-05 |website=nos.nl |language=nl}} On 1 August, Edwards was waived by the Timberwolves.{{Cite web|title=Jesse Edwards: Let go by Minnesota|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/jesse-edwards-let-go-by-minnesota/|access-date=October 26, 2025|website=cbssports.com|language=en}} On 12 August 2025, Edwards signed with [[Melbourne United]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL).{{Cite web |title=United's high-flying final addition |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/uniteds-high-flying-final-addition |access-date=August 12, 2025 |website=nbl.com.au |date=August 12, 2025 |language=en}} On 10 March 2026, Edwards signed with [[Saski Baskonia|Baskonia]] of the [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite web |title=Jesse Edwards, nueva pieza para el juego interior de Kosner Baskonia |url=https://www.baskonia.com/es/noticias/jesse-edwards-nueva-pieza-para-el-juego-interior-de-kosner-baskonia |access-date=March 10, 2026 |website=baskonia.com |date=March 10, 2026 |language=es}} On July 10, 2026, Edwards signed with [[BC Roma SPQR|Roma SPQR]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web|title=Roma adds Dutch center Jesse Edwards|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/eurocup/news/roma-adds-dutch-center-jesse-edwards/|date=July 10, 2026|website=euroleaguebasketball.net|access-date=August 12, 2026}} However, on August 31, his contract was mutually terminated before appearing in any game.{{Cite web|title=BC Roma SPQR, ufficiale la risoluzione con Jesse Edwards|url=https://www.legabasket.it/news/139387/bc-roma-risoluzione-jesse-edwards|date=August 31, 2026|website=legabasket.it|access-date=September 1, 2026|language=it}} ==National team career== In July 2021, Edwards joined the training camp of the [[Netherlands men's national basketball team|Netherlands senior team]] for the first time, along with his brother [[Kai Edwards (basketball)|Kai]].{{cite web|title=Orange Lions op trainingskamp met veel talenten van college|url=https://www.basketball.nl/nieuwsoverzicht/orange-lions-op-trainingskamp-met-veel-talenten-van-college/|website=Basketball.nl|access-date=15 December 2021|language=nl}} He was selected for the qualification games of the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup]]. On 2 July 2022, Edwards debuted in a 66–67 away loss against [[Iceland men's national basketball team|Iceland]] in which he had six points, seven rebounds, and two blocks in ten minutes of playing time.{{cite web|title=De Orange Lions hebben nagelaten hun uitgangspositie voor de volgende fase van de WK-kwalificatie een boost te geven.|url=https://www.basketball.nl/nieuwsoverzicht/orange-lions-doen-zichzelf-tekort-en-laten-zege-door-de-vingers-glippen-tegen-ijsland/|website=Basketball.nl|access-date=3 July 2022|language=nl}} In August 2022, Edwards rejoined the national team to participate in international competitions which includes [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification|World Cup qualifying]] and the [[Eurobasket]].{{cite news|title=Edwards Joins Dutch National Team|url=https://cuse.com/news/2022/8/13/mens-basketball-edwards-joins-dutch-national-team.aspx|work=Syracuse University Athletics|date=13 August 2022|access-date=15 August 2022}} He was on the 12-man roster for [[EuroBasket 2022]].{{cite web |date=30 August 2022 |title=Netherlands announced final 12-player roster for EuroBasket |url=https://basketnews.com/news-177149-netherlands-announced-final-12-player-roster-for-eurobasket.html |access-date=30 August 2022 |website=BasketNews.com}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player
